description: The bar chart, titled "NDCG@10", illustrates the Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain at position 10 for three different interaction types: critiquing, scoring, and ranking. The horizontal axis displays these interaction types, while the vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25. The chart shows that the "critiquing" interaction has the highest NDCG@10 score, with a value of approximately 0.21, represented by a tall orange bar. The "scoring" interaction has a score of approximately 0.19, shown by a blue bar. The "ranking" interaction has the lowest score, at approximately 0.12, also represented by a blue bar. The bars are arranged in descending order of value from left to right.
